market_size.evidence: Finland has 16,690 km and Europe roughly 190,000 km of district heating network, but the reachable segment (older networks without working alarm wires) suggests only a few million euros a year in the Nordics, and the figures come from my own sensor-spacing and price assumptions.

route_to_market.evidence: One utility has asked for a 2027 pilot and there are natural licensees or partners (Vexve, Gutermann or its distributors, Kamstrup), but utility procurement is slow, the team has no business experience, and the pre-filing publication puts IP at risk.

competition.evidence: Alarm wires are standard on new pipes, Gutermann loggers already do nightly neighbour correlation on district heating networks via DWI, Kamstrup holds a 2026 US patent on acoustic district heating leak detection, and thermal surveys are established; the self-calibration is a real but narrow difference.
